message: The other day, my kids were busy building a fort out of couch cushions while I was trying to gather supplies for the impending storm. I couldn’t decide if I should join them or stick to my grown-up duties. In the end, I brought my flashlight into the fort, and we had a little emergency preparedness session right in our living room. Turns out, a little fun goes a long way in making readiness feel less like a chore and more like an adventure. When was the last time you mixed prepping with play?
